levels.title: Low Apparent Concern
levels.description: No obvious physical damage or abnormal behavior has been observed during the preliminary inspection, and no known safety concern has been reported.

levels.title: Minor Concerns
levels.description: The battery may be degraded, faulty, or previously repaired, but the originator has not identified an obvious acute safety concern.

levels.title: Elevated Concern or Uncertainty
levels.description: Concerning observations, unusual behavior, a history of damage, or significant uncertainty about the battery’s condition warrants additional assessment or precautions.

levels.title: High Safety Concern
levels.description: Serious damage, suspected internal failure, significant leakage, or other observations suggest that specialist assessment or controlled handling may be necessary.

levels.title: Critical Hazard Suspected
levels.description: An active thermal event, smoke, fire, or another observation indicates a potentially immediate or critical hazard.
